name: OIDC Audience Confusion/Mismatch Attack
description: Attacker presents a JWT token with a mismatched audience claim to bypass authorization checks, gaining access to a service that fails to properly validate the audience field
real_world_relevance: Azure AD audience confusion CVE-2021-42306, Google Cloud IAP audience bypass, common in microservice architectures using shared OIDC providers without strict audience validation

techniques.name: Use Alternate Authentication Material: Application Access Token

attack_flow.description: Attacker obtains a valid OIDC token for one service and presents it to a different service that shares the same identity provider but fails to validate the audience claim
diagram: 1. Attacker obtains OIDC token for Service A (low-privilege)
2. Inspect JWT claims to identify the audience (aud) field
3. Present the token to Service B which trusts the same IdP
4. Service B fails to validate audience, accepts the token
5. Attacker gains unauthorized access to Service B resources

phases.name: Token Acquisition for Service A
phases.description: Obtain a legitimate OIDC token intended for a low-privilege service

actions.description: Request OIDC token with audience claim for Service A

phases.name: Audience Confusion Attack
phases.description: Present Service A token to Service B endpoint

indicators_of_compromise.description: OIDC audience mismatch detected in token exchange
JWT presented with unexpected audience claim

expected_wazuh_alerts.description: NHI: OIDC audience mismatch detected in token exchange
NHI: JWT presented with unexpected audience claim

immediate: Audit all services for audience validation in JWT verification logic
Revoke any tokens that may have been used in audience confusion attacks
Review access logs for cross-service token usage patterns
long_term: Enforce strict audience validation in all token verification middleware
Use unique audience values per service rather than shared audiences
Implement token binding to prevent cross-service token replay
Deploy API gateways with centralized audience validation
